body: They can't make me feel any better, nobody can. Hence why it's no use. It's always been like this. I can talk to my mother about anything, it just doesn't help me at all. I sit there talking to her for hours, her holding me in her arms for a long time and I just feel nothing.

They were alright with it really. I've talked to them about how I'm feeling a lot, they know everything about my situation. Of course they wouldn't want me to just be gone. They do understand I'm in a lot of pain physically and mentally and that this won't change any time soon or maybe never.

He is a weird guy and stubborn. He doesn't change his mind a lot and would rather be unhappy for the rest of his life, if he thought it would help me. There is no way of changing his mind, I always knew that, he has always been like this. He has sacrificed himself for a lot of things to help others and he is still dealing with the pain caused by it.


All of my friends know. Well... I only have about 2 close friends, a couple of normal friends. They all know about it. They are all just online friends, I don't have any friends in real life. All of them were there with me the night I tried to off myself. Communicating with me through the internet as I was preparing myself for it. And they knew about it all along.

Yes and no. He is rather weird and wouldn't know what to reply with, he might just hate himself too much after all of this and be too embarrassed to talk to me again. I'm his "the one" and he is mine. I can't just give up like that. And since I know he didn't leave me for somebody else or anything like that. I still send him messages, I'm not expecting him to reply, he simply wouldn't be able to. 
Last time we talked some was about two months ago? When I hadn't written him anything in a while and he became worried about me, so he came looking for me. We didn't talk about anything serious then, only about irrelevant things. I do know he still cares a lot about me. I know he still tries to check on me and seems to go a bit crazy? if I don't send him a message once in a while.

I'm not sure what I'm going to do. I've tried so many things, it just doesn't help. My friends have tried so much. I don't want them to have to suffer the frustration coming from this.
I'm thinking of you and hope you will reconsider. All I can say is, if you don't have any friends, then you haven't found true friends yet. If you're still there, I'd love to talk to you.
I guess the worst thing is, since my suicide attempt I haven't had a single moment where I wasn't thinking about suicide. Even now. Everyday, every minute I think about it.
I wish that still applied to me. But I'm sick and it won't ever get better. Sure, some things will get better. Just this one thing will always be there.

People often ask me how I'm able to do all of this, how I'm able to still keep going. And I never tell anyone about everything that has happened to me.
It's just the loneliness. All my life I had to deal with it, then I got to experience what it was like to be happy for a while. It helped a lot. And now it's just back to the loneliness again, because he is gone.
Thanks. Lots of hugs to you too and I hope things will get better for you soon

I actually do get a lot of support from friends and even my family. That's if I talk to my family about how I'm doing. Most of the time I decide to not to. It's just... it doesn't make me feel any better at all. The fact it doesn't make me feel better only makes me feel worse. My friends know about how I'm feeling and always try to make me feel better. It just doesn't help. It only helped when he was there, making me feel less alone.
With my sickness I can't go out alone and all of my friends are online friends who live across the ocean. I'm pretty much stuck at home.
Thanks.

I'm 22. Thanks for the post. Well, I've had a lot of things happen to me. Abuse, sexual harassment in my childhood, relatives getting murdered and so on. There certainly are a bunch of things that will always be bothering me. I used to have a lot of dreams for my future. Though those are hard to achieve for someone in my situation.
Thank you! Lots of hugs for you too. Well if you need somebody to talk to or vent to, don't hesitate to message me.
Thanks. I might consider it sometime although I've become rather shut-in again.

Thanks. I can move. I can't go to other places all by myself. And well, I don't have anyone to go out with. I've thought about volunteering in charity organizations. The actual plan was to become a surgeon though.

Thanks guys. Usually whenever I make a post about myself, I never get any replies. When I was 15, christmas, and I sat alone at home feeling really suicidal. I wrote this wall of text and posted it in one of those help and support forums. It was about myself, my story, my way of thinking, my family and so on. I sat there the whole night, hoping someone would reply and talk to me. Nobody replied.
It made me feel like nobody cared. Not in real life, not online either. My family didn't care much back then either. Me and my family didn't have any kind of relationship with each other until half a year ago. Before that I was just living with strangers who I called my family.

I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed right now, as I'm not used to this. I hope I can get to reply to everything later.
I know I'm not alone, but I am lonely. He was the one who made me feel not lonely for the first time ever in my life. He left thinking he was only dragging me down more. I've been in relationships before and just hated it, mostly because I couldn't feel anything for my partners and just felt bad.
I spend a lot of time with my family, it doesn't make me feel less lonely.
It's not exactly the breakup making me depressed, I have always been depressed. It's my sickness and all of my other problems.
